accounting_contract.accumulation_xor_logical_transfers: source and destination reads plus destination write
accounting_contract.butterfly_logical_transfers: two shard reads plus two shard writes
accounting_contract.fixed_multiply_logical_transfers: one shard read plus one shard write
accounting_contract.ideal_fused_lower_bound: butterfly traffic only; all factor, tail-input, and accumulation traffic is unrealistically free and therefore only an upper bound on possible improvement
accounting_contract.materialized_candidate: optimistic transform-stage traffic plus separate fixed-multiply and accumulation passes; repeated input staging, final output placement, packing, scatter, allocator, and cache-line effects excluded
accounting_contract.padded_baseline: optimistic transform-stage traffic under the same exclusions
accounting_contract.schedule_record_model: 32-byte header plus 16 bytes per block and active coset
accounting_contract.scratch_slots: full shard slots excluding caller input/output
accounting_contract.setup_amortization: one incremental candidate schedule divided over batch * plan_reuse_count stripes

disposition.exact_reason: all representative GF16 input/output block pairs remain coupled, the global parity map is dense, and explicit join storage/execution is additional work; a different factored exact algorithm is not disproved
disposition.parent_wire_low_memory_note: largest-block scratch can be smaller than the parent, but C1/C2 pruned or tiled parent schedules should own that opportunity
disposition.parent_wire_reason: no representative GF16 geometry reaches the 10 percent promotion threshold with separate materialized accumulation; the only symbolic ceiling above 10 percent assumes free fusion, factor, tail-input, and accumulation traffic and belongs in the general C1/C2 parent scheduler
